thread:
Jane_Auditor: Hi team, auditor request — can you provide single-source evidence showing the RBAC change to the 'model-ingest' service account on 2025-02-03, the related CloudTrail entries, and the KMS key usage that ties the deploy to a key rotation? Need chain-of-custody for SOC2 control testing.
Mira_Security: Sure. Root change was the addition of role role/model-ingest-runner to serviceAccount:svc-model-ingest@redwood.internal at 2025-02-03T15:12Z. I can pull CloudTrail and KMS usage. Do you want raw exports or a packaged zip with README + hashes? :file_folder:
Jane_Auditor: Packaged zip please, with checksums and the exact splunk/ct query used to extract events. Also include a small narrative (2-3 lines) that maps the artifacts to control objectives.
Pete_Infra: I can produce the CloudTrail export and the S3 presigned link. Will also include the lambda that archived the events. Note: CT shows the IAM change occurred after a deploy job, build #2025-134.
Sam_OnCall: Oncall confirmation — the deploybot posted the rollback marker for that deploy at 2025-02-03T15:18Z. I captured the deploy job ID and the k8s rollout diff.
deploybot: [deploy] job 2025-134 started by pipeline:ci (commit: a1b2c3d), finished status=success, rollback_marker=false, image=registry.redwood/ingest:v2.4.1
Mira_Security: Splunk query used: `index=cloudtrail eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy userIdentity.principalId=svc-model-ingest* earliest=02/03/2025:15:00:00 latest=02/03/2025:15:30:00` — that returned the PutRolePolicy + AttachRolePolicy entries. For KMS: `eventName=Encrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/abcd-rot-2025 earliest=02/03/2025` gave the key usage map.
Mira_Security: Packaging plan: artifacts/ (README.md, checksums.sha256, cloudtrail_events.jsonl, kms_usage.csv, deploy_job_log.txt, k8s_rollout_diff.patch, narrative.md). I will sign checksums with our build key.
Pete_Infra: S3 export path: s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-02-03/ingest-rbac-change-1709812345.tar.gz. Presigned link expires in 7 days. Will attach the manifest with md5/sha256 and the CI job link.
Sam_OnCall: Added incident tag: NONE (this was not a security incident), vuln triage note: the change was requested as part of feature FLAG-241; security review = approved. I verified no abnormal auth attempts in the 24h after change.
Jane_Auditor: Two clarifications: 1) evidence that the key used was on a scheduled rotation and 2) who approved the RBAC change (name + timestamp).
Mira_Security: Approval audit: PR #3421 merged by @lena_pm at 2025-02-03T14:58Z — GitHub link included in narrative.md. KMS rotation: key arn:.../abcd-rot-2025 is in rotation schedule (monthly) — rotation window records are in KMS console exports; I'll include key metadata JSON showing NextRotationDate and LastRotated.
Pete_Infra: Also including CloudTrail lookup for `kms:ReEncrypt` with requestParameters.encryptionContext to show it was used by the deploy job. Example line we will include in kms_usage.csv: `2025-02-03T15:13:02Z,arn:key/abcd-rot-2025,Encrypt,svc-model-ingest,deploy-job-2025-134`
Jane_Auditor: That looks good. One more ask: evidence that access reviews cover this service account (attestation).
Mira_Security: We have an access-review spreadsheet entry (access-review-2025Q1.csv) showing svc-model-ingest reviewed on 2025-03-01 by @talal_id; I'll include the signed attestation PDF.
Sam_OnCall: Quick note for packaging: include `kubectl get rolebinding -n platform model-ingest -o yaml` output and the git commit for infra changes.
Jane_Auditor: Perfect. Please upload zip and post the S3 presigned link and checksum here when ready. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Mira_Security: Uploaded s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-02-03/ingest-rbac-change-1709812345.tar.gz (presigned: https://presign.example/ingest-rbac-change-1709812345.tar.gz). SHA256: 9f2b...c7e1. Narrative attached explains mapping to SOC2 control CC6.2 and ISO 27001 A.9.2.
Jane_Auditor: Received and validated checksums. Thanks team — this package satisfies the auditor's evidence request for the change and key usage.
Sam_OnCall: Closing the loop: I've added a postmortem-lite note in the ops board indicating checklist items were followed.
Pete_Infra: If auditor wants deeper logs (VPC flow, s3 access) ping me and I'll extend the export.
Jane_Auditor: Will review and follow up if needed. Appreciated.
